sessions.notes: The best entries combine accurate height comparisons with a specific editorial takeaway and readable phone layouts. E04 stands out for replacing its desktop skyline with directly labeled phone bars, while E01 has a particularly strong headline and E15 integrates the phone data effectively. Separate numbered indexes, tiny supporting text and horizontal clipping weaken otherwise polished work. E10, E16 and E21 retain correct data indexes but have empty central chart areas on both screens; screenshot cutoffs and hidden credit spaces were not treated as defects.

The best entries combine accurate common scales with a clear editorial point and phone layouts that keep building identities and exact values easy to read. Directly labeled comparisons reduce the effort of consulting separate numbered indexes, while well-scaled architectural silhouettes add useful visual character. Small secondary type, hidden phone chart labels and horizontal overflow distinguish the weaker functioning entries. The three entries with blank main graphics retain accurate data indexes but lose their central visual comparison and waste substantial screen space. Screenshot boundaries and anonymized credit spaces were not treated as defects.

The best posters combine accurate zero-based comparisons, a specific editorial takeaway, and phone layouts that keep names and metadata close to the values. E05 offers the strongest combination of architectural character and an integrated mobile chart, while E20 adds particularly useful quantitative commentary. Separate numbered indexes, tiny secondary text, and horizontal clipping weaken otherwise polished entries. E10, E11, and E21 retain accurate data indexes but have visibly empty main chart regions on both screens; ordinary screenshot cutoffs and hidden credit areas were not treated as defects. HTML packaging and interactive behavior cannot be verified from these images.

exclusionReason: Blinding version 1 hid the complete Flint/Vega charts by misclassifying their accessible labels as logos. These 63 scores and all three rankings are invalid and are excluded from every final quality aggregate.
